name: handstand
text: Hold a stationary handstand on both palms flat on the floor, arms extended, legs together pointing vertically upward. Small balance adjustments without walking the hands.
support: hands centered about origin, wrist centers at mean 5.5cm, seated flat-palm orientation

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 双掌朝向地面、双腿向上的倒立保持循环；复用进入倒立试片的静态姿态，调整掌向和支撑高度后生成。最低关节点约+2厘米，允许小幅平衡变化，不是零位移锁掌。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
